mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.pid, m.type, m.name, m.icon, m.sort, m.perms, m.paths, m.component, m.selected, m.params, m.is_cache, m.is_show, m.is_disable, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM hou_mall_system_menu m INNER JOIN hou_mall_system_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN hou_mall_admin_role ar ON ar.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND m.is_disable = 0 AND m.type IN ('M', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY m.sort DESC, m.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM hou_mall_system_menu m INNER JOIN hou_mall_system_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN hou_mall_admin_role ar ON ar.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND m.is_disable = 0 AND m.type IN ('A', 'B') AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' ORDER BY m.sort DESC, m.id ASC
